title: Superinduce
summary: SUPERINDU'CE, verb transitive [super and induce.] To bring in or upon as an addition to something; as, to superinduce a virtue or quality upon a person not before possessing it. Long custom of sinning

inlines.v: SUPERINDU'CE, verb transitive [super and induce.] To bring in or upon as an addition to something; as, to superinduce a virtue or quality upon a person not before possessing it. Long custom of sinning superinduces upon the soul new and absurd desires.
